powers.HUMAN_FACE_COLUMN_POWER.description:
[blue]6[/blue] layers; [blue]3[/blue] exposed at a time.
The top takes no damage. The middle takes [blue]50%[/blue] less damage.
Breaking the bottom layer [gold]Stuns[/gold] the former middle layer for a turn.
